title: Pradhan
desc: When an honest policeman is transferred to Dharmapur, he encounters widespread corruption and fights to stay true to his principles.

title: Sukh Dukher Sansar
desc: Amar, the eldest of four, struggles to provide a better life to his younger siblings. However, things take a turn for the worse when his younger sister meets with an accident and is visually impaired.

title: Abhagini
desc: Abhagini is tortured by her stepmother all her life, but she decides to make a new start after leaving the city. Initially, the new family she is living with dislikes her, but she soon wins them over.

title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.
